body.name: Simultaneous multiplier ellipses
body.construction: Generate independent \(\xi_{g,i}\), compute \(Z^\star\), take \(\widehat c_{1-\gamma}\in[0,\infty)\) as the conditional quantile of \(\max_{1\le j\le J}(Z_j^\star)^{\mathsf T}(\widehat V_{\mathrm{adj},jj}^{R})^{-1}Z_j^\star\), and return \(\mathcal E_j=\{u\in\mathbb R^2:(n/L_n)(\widehat\tau_j-u)^{\mathsf T}(\widehat V_{\mathrm{adj},jj}^{R})^{-1}(\widehat\tau_j-u)\le\widehat c_{1-\gamma}\}\) for \(1\leq j\leq J\).
